steps.message:
# Some coins misbehave in the flooded cave

### What happens
`recording.mp4` is an uncut run through a flooded cave basin. Partway through the clip, Tux does something that releases a group of new coins. From that moment until the end of the clip, those coins do not behave the way coins in this game should. The coins that were already placed in the level, Tux, the fish and the scenery in the recording are correct.

### Expected
The released coins should behave like a normal coin burst in this game, from the moment they spread out of the block until they come to rest and Tux collects them on contact. Once a coin is in the water it should drift down slowly. Fix every way the released coins behave wrongly in the recording.

## Attached visual evidence

- `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4` (44 seconds)

You can inspect individual moments of the video by extracting frames from it with `ffmpeg`.

Inspect the attached file before making changes.

I've made four fixes to the released coins, but I haven't confirmed they compile yet. A full rebuild is running in the background and I'll report the result when it finishes. I also couldn't watch the recording: `/app/.harbor_assets/` is empty and there's no `recording.mp4` anywhere on the system. So these fixes come from reading the code, not from the video.

A block that releases a burst of coins creates `CoinExplode`, which spawns `HeavyCoin` objects. The fixes:

1. **Spread direction** (`src/object/coin_explode.cpp`): the left/right sign was being applied to the vertical speed instead of the horizontal one. So half the coins shot downward and none went left. They now fan out to both sides and all start moving upward.
2. **Can't be collected** (`src/object/coin.cpp`): the released coins were in a collision group that only checks against solid ground, so touching Tux never registered. They're now in the normal moving group, so Tux picks them up on contact.
3. **Never settle**: a coin bounced again whenever it landed moving faster than 20, so it kept hopping, and its sideways speed was never cleared, so it slid along the floor. Now it bounces only above a landing speed of 200, and otherwise stops completely.
4. **Water**: the coins ignored water. Inside water they now fall under one-fifth gravity, with horizontal movement scaled to 0.4 and vertical to 0.6, the same values rocks use. They drift down slowly.

The coins that drop from a coin-rain block use the same `HeavyCoin` class, so fixes 2–4 apply to them as well. I didn't find anything wrong in the rain code itself. Once it compiles, the remaining check is to play the flooded cave and watch a burst spread, sink, settle and get collected.
